name: NEPI Rockcastle N.V.
source: CRON 2026-11-12: H1 2026 column added from NEPI Rockcastle N.V. reviewed interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (SENS, 19 August 2026), EUR thousand scaled to units. Printed lines: Gross rental income 318,583 + Service charge income 157,423 + Revenue from energy activity 7,574 + Revenue from sales of inventory property 0 = Revenue 483,580; Property operating expenses 164,043 + Operating expense related to energy activity 1,852 = Cost of Sales 165,895; Revenue less Cost of Sales equals the printed Net rental and related income 317,685, stored as Gross Profit. Administrative expenses 19,496 gives the printed EBIT 298,189. Net Finance Costs is Finance costs 52,656 less Finance income 3,259 plus Bank charges, commissions and fees 2,527 = 51,924. Profit before tax 369,858 less Income tax expense 72,675 equals Profit after tax 297,183. EBIT less Net Finance Costs does not bridge to Profit before tax because the panel has no row for the printed Fair value adjustments of investment property 126,201, foreign exchange loss 1,501 and fair value adjustments of derivatives 1,107; the printed profit before tax is stored as filed. Basic EPS 42.01 euro cents stored as 0.4201. Margin ratios are computed from this column; ROE, ROA and Debt to Equity are left empty because they need the interim balance sheet, which this column does not carry. | Yahoo Finance
